results.title: Bitcoin price today: BTC recovers to $80,800 ahead of Fed meeting
results.content:
More than $810 million in cryptocurrency positions were liquidated over 24 hours, including approximately $689 million in bullish bets, according to Coinglass data.

Thin weekend liquidity intensified selling pressure as leveraged positions were forcibly closed following Bitcoin’s decline below $80,000. Bitcoin was trading at $80,936.3 as of 00:53 ET (04:53 GMT), inching closer to $81,000. [...] Higher interest rates could pressure Bitcoin by strengthening the dollar and reducing demand for riskier assets, while a less hawkish outlook could support a recovery.

Elevated oil prices have complicated the outlook, with Brent crude trading above $117 amid the Iran war, raising concerns about persistent inflation.

Bitcoin fell as low as $79,146 on Saturday, its weakest level in more than a month, before reclaiming the psychologically important $80,000 threshold. [...] Bitcoin also slipped beneath its 50-day moving average near $81,700, with traders monitoring potential support around $78,400 and $77,876.

Meanwhile, corporate Bitcoin treasury companies face growing challenges balancing cryptocurrency purchases against financing obligations.

According to Fidelity Digital Assets, perpetual preferred stock offerings have financed purchases of approximately 136,000 Bitcoin since 2025.

results.title: Bitcoin Price on Its 18th Birthday: Here's What History Predicts for BTC
results.content:
The cryptocurrency began without an established market price before eventually reaching successive cycle highs in 2013, 2017, 2021 and 2025.

Historical price data shows Bitcoin closing near $19,188 at its December 2017 peak and approximately $67,559 in November 2021.

Its October 2025 record close exceeded $124,700, although subsequent losses demonstrated that institutional adoption has not eliminated Bitcoin's volatility. [...] Bitcoin is approaching its 18th birthday, but the cryptocurrency's historically strong October performance has yet to deliver the rally investors might have expected.

On Oct. 31, 2026, Bitcoin will mark 18 years since Satoshi Nakamoto published the white paper proposing a decentralized electronic payment system.

The anniversary arrives with BTC trading around $81,700 on Oct. 20, approximately 35% below its October 2025 record closing price of $124,700. [...] Key Takeaways

 Bitcoin's white paper turns 18 on Oct. 31, 2026, marking nearly two decades since Satoshi Nakamoto introduced the cryptocurrency.
 Bitcoin has historically gained in 10 of the past 13 Octobers, with an average monthly return of approximately 19%.
 BTC is trading near $82,000, roughly 35% below its October 2025 record, raising questions about whether its birthday could coincide with a recovery.

results.title: Bitcoin (BTC) price recovers to $81,700 as memecoins lead altcoin rebound
results.content:
Summary

Show

   Bitcoin rose 0.5% to around $81,700 since midnight UTC, recovering from a low of around $81,000, while Asian stocks steadied after Thursday’s tech sell-off.
   Altcoins moved faster, with the CoinDesk 80 gaining 1.4%, memecoins climbing 2.9% and frog-themed memecoin pepe jumping 13%.
   Traders are now looking to the Fed’s Oct. 27-28 meeting. [...] BTC and ETH, majors see quiet rebuilding:Futures open interest rose about 1% in both coins while their prices barely moved, indicating a modest build in new positions. Liquidations fell sharply, by about two-thirds in bitcoin and a third in ether. Bitcoin funding rose to 0.0067% from 0.0041%, so longs are paying a little more to hold. Ether funding is flat. [...] The CD100’s weakest monthly performers also rose, with doublezero 2Z$0.03202 up 2.5% and monad MON$0.02196 up 4.3%, though they remain down 49% and 31% over the month.
   CoinMarketCap’s “Altcoin Season” indicator is at 58/100, rising from Monday’s low of 54/100 as positive sentiment continues to impact the altcoin sector during bitcoin’s tight trading range.
